caption_versions.specificity:
Why won't this video play at home?

Because it's a Reflection. On the map, in the feed and on a profile you only see a preview. The full video — up to 10 seconds, filmed in AR — plays only in AR, near the spot where it was recorded.

To watch it, you go there.

Which spot would you lock a video to? One word in the comments.
